summary: The root زري (zry) in the اِفْتَعَلَ form, as in اِزْدَرَىٰ (izdarā), primarily means to despise, disdain, or hold in contempt.

headwords.def: ازرى بِهِ , inf. n. إِزْرَآءٌ , He held it (i. e. a thing, S, Msb, or a case, or an affair, K) in little, or light, or mean, estimation, or in contempt; (S, Mgh, Msb, K;) as also . headwords.def: زَارٍ عَلَى إِنْسَانٍ Blaming, finding fault with, or reproving, a man; or being angry with him, with the anger that proceeds from a friend; and being displeased with him: thus in a verse of Mejnoon cited voce اِسْتَدَامَ : (S, TA:) making no account of a man, and disapproving his conduct. (AA, Msb, TA.)
